units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:10">Targ. O. Gen. XV, 10</cite> (ed. Berl. <cite ref="Q00935"><he>פַּלַג</he></cite>; ed. Vien. <cite ref="Q00962"><he>פִּלּוּג</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 25:10">Targ. Ex. XXV, 10</cite> (Y. also <cite ref="Q00210"><he>פּוּלְגָּא</he></cite>); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 16:3">Targ. I Chr. XVI, 3</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q00961"><he>פְּלוּג</he></cite>.]—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 62b:10">B. Bath. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ דאית לי בארעא פ׳</he> if the deed reads, ‘the half share which is mine in that field’, he has sold half the field (his entire share); <he>פ׳ בארעא דאית לי ריבעא</he> but if it reads, ‘half of that field which is mine’, he has sold him one fourth of the field (or half his share).
Ib. מצר ארעא דמינה פ׳ פ׳ (Ms. M. פְּלִיגָא) if he writes, ‘these are the borders of the field of which I sell a portion’, it means half, contrad. to פְּסִיקָא; ib. 63ᵃ.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89b:5">Sabb. 89ᵇ</cite> <he>דל תרתי סרי ופ׳ וכ׳</he> deduct (from the years of life) twelve years and a half for prayer, eating &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 89b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>פ׳ עלי ופ׳ עלך</he> let me bear the failings of half the remaining years, and bear thou the other half.

<cite ref="Pesachim 79b:2">Pes. 79ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳ ופ׳</he> equal numbers on both sides. Y. Kidd. IV, 65ᶜ top <he>דבהתין פַּלְגּוֹן מן פלגון</he> (not <he>מן פלג</he>) one half of them is afraid of the other half of them; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 8">Num. R. s. 8</cite> <he>פלגין מן פלגין</he> (corr. acc.); a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>פַּלְגַּיָּא</he>, <cite ref="Q00946"><he>פַּלְגֵּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 15:11">Ib. 11</cite> ed. Berl. (v. <cite ref="Q00095"><he>פִּגְרָא</he></cite>); a. e.—

senses.gloss: רוח פלגא the demon Palga, a disease (paralysis?).
